vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: This repository packages Spotify Portal workflows for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and pi.

`skills/` contains the canonical Portal workflow instructions. Fleetshift workflows live there as `fleetshift-<workflow>` because hosts only discover skills one level deep (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`), so they can't be grouped in a subfolder.
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
